title: Boat Rentals at Lake Anne (Reston Association)

services.name: Boat rental
services.desc: Yes, boats can be rented at Lake Anne Plaza, including kayaks and pedal boats. Rentals are available from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend, Friday, from 3 to 7 pm, and 9 am to 8 pm on Saturday and Sunday. blurb: Reston Association offers boat rentals at Lake Anne. Guests can enjoy paddling on the lake during the operating season. The association manages the lake and related recreational activities.
